title: Handling Credit by Fulfilment Mode and Line Count — Cartwise Grocery Orders Over-Cap Reviews
content:
Cartwise Grocery Orders adds a handling credit to the over-cap amount registered for review on a line billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found. It is added after the missing refund standing on the order has been taken off (the remainder never below zero), and it turns on the order's service level and its number of billed item lines:

- when the order's service level delivers and the order has **at least 5** billed item lines, the credit is **0.75**;
- when the service level delivers and the order has **fewer than 5** billed item lines, it is **0.50**;
- for a pickup order there is none.

A service level delivers when its fulfilment mode is delivery: No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery, Priority Delivery, Express 30 Delivery and Stock-Up Delivery. Curbside Pickup is the pickup service level. Billed item lines are counted from the order's billed item line charge entries.

### Decision table

| Service level | Billed item lines | Handling credit |
|---|---|---|
| Delivery service level | 5 or more | 0.75 |
| Delivery service level | 1 to 4 | 0.50 |
| Curbside Pickup | any | none |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical orders)

- Standard Delivery order with 5 billed item lines: 0.75. The same order with 4 billed item lines: 0.50.
- Curbside Pickup order with 12 billed item lines: none.
- Stock-Up Delivery order with 30 billed item lines and an over-cap figure of 16.10 left after the missing refund is taken off: 16.85 once the credit is added.
